title: Queso-Style Turkish Chicken Dumplings
description: A kid-friendly Turkish dish made with herbs, mayonnaise, and infuse-oil, served in banana leaves.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chicken breast, flour, parsley, mint, garlic powder, and kosher salt.
Gradually add water and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces.
Shape each piece into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add 1 tablespoon of infuse-oil.
Cook 4-6 dumplings at a time, until golden brown on both sides.
Transfer cooked dumplings to banana leaves and cover with mayonnaise.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
